title: IIFL Finance up 6% after Fairfax block deal

timeline.title: IIFL Finance up 6% after Fairfax block deal
timeline.line: About 13% of the lender changed hands pre-market at a ₹611 floor
more: Fairfax's FIH Mauritius offered up to 13.25%, worth about ₹3,454 cr
Floor price was a 3.9% discount to Tuesday's ₹636.05 close
Follows last week's ₹6,414 cr capital raise with Blackstone

src.title: IIFL Finance shares gain 6% after block deal; Fairfax likely seller
